thread:
Maya P: Heads-up — planning a minor rollforward of the engine (v2.19.0) + new quant profile (q2-small) to slice-7 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Who's owning the deploy and smoke?

Raj K: I can own the deployment window. My slot is 02:45-04:15 UTC.

Sam T: I'll take smoke validation and perf checks post-deploy (03:05-03:25). Will run the usual latency/correctness suite.

Maya P: awesome. @Raj K please follow the rollback checklist in ops-runbook if anything looks off. Also ensure the staging gate passed — it did earlier today.

Raj K: yup staging passed. I tagged the canary group and verified kv-cache behavior.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by Raj K for 2026-03-18 03:00:00 UTC on slice-7. Canary group = 5% traffic.

Luis G: FYI for observability: add the extra trace tags for kernel_version and quant_profile so we can filter quickly. I'll add dashboards for quant regressions.

Olivia Z: For rollback readiness — I've pre-staged the previous kernel image (v2.18.4) and marked snapshots. If rollback required I can trigger stage-to-prod in <10m.

Sam T: Smoke test plan (short):
```
1) run `make smoke` on slice-7 smoke harness
2) 5x latency p95 check vs baseline (script: tooling/smoke/p95-check.sh)
3) 100 infer requests with common prompt set, compare embeddings/qscore diffs
```

Maya P: Nice. Please add a short note in the thread if you observe >5% degradation on p95 or any API-level errors. We'll hold the rollout if errors spike.

Raj K: Quick ops checklist I'm running before deploy:
- drain slot-1 from batch pool
- lock rollout window in cadence
- ensure autoscaler enabled
- confirm model variant compatibility (q2-small -> ok)

Sam T: I'll run the reranking/regression eval after 5m of traffic. If hit, I'll annotate examples and ping #eng-ml.

Luis G: Added dashboard panels: quant_profile=q2-small and kernel=v2.19.0. Also set an alert for token-error-rate >0.2%.

Olivia Z: Oncall contact: @platform-oncall (secondary: @infra-sre). I DM'd them the rollback playbook.

Raj K: starting deploy in 5m. tagging @Sam T & @Maya P.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Raj K. Canary slice-7 -> 5% traffic. Job id: jb-20260318-01

Sam T: Canary smoke started. running p95 check now.

Sam T: p95 looks +3% vs baseline, within expected. No obvious errors in logs.

Luis G: seeing expected KV hit rate improvements. No token-errors so far.

Olivia Z: ready to rollback if we exceed thresholds. Standby.

Raj K: promoting canary to 25% (manual) in 10m unless Sam or Maya flag it.

Sam T: hold — seeing a small regression in long-context throughput for one model shard. investigating.

Maya P: Hold promotion. @Raj K pause promotion. Sam please collect top 5 failing traces and dump KV cache state.

Sam T: Dumped and uploaded traces to s3://redwood-dev/rollforward/2012345678/traces.tar.gz. Noting a mem spike on host-7 leading to slightly higher latency on long seqs.

Luis G: mem spike correlates with kernel thread scheduling change in v2.19.0. I'll open an infra ticket but we can rollback if it persists post quick patch.

Olivia Z: If rollback: I'll execute rollback job rb-20260318-01 (v2.18.4) and confirm health probes.

Raj K: rolling back to v2.18.4 now per Maya + Sam.

deploy-bot: Rollback started by Raj K. Job id: rb-20260318-01.

Sam T: Smoke after rollback: p95 back to baseline, memory stable, no errors.

Maya P: Thanks team. Good call. We'll schedule a follow-up to investigate kernel scheduling impact and try a targeted patch before next attempt.

Raj K: I'll capture exact steps and timeline in the deploy runbook and ping infra + eng-runtime for root-cause analysis.

Luis G: I'll triage kernel scheduling diff and propose a micro-change for testing.

Olivia Z: Closing the loop: rollback verified and slice-7 healthy. If anyone wants the playback, I recorded the session and put it in the deploy run folder. :white_check_mark:
